shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
Cooking new recipes brings me joy and satisfaction.
I enjoy hiking in the mountains during the weekends.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
Traveling to new places expands my understanding of cultures.
Gardening teaches me patience and the importance of care.
Volunteer work in my community has been very rewarding.
Photography allows me to capture beautiful moments in life.
Writing in my journal helps me reflect on my personal growth.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you've had?
Q2: What challenges do you often face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal development?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first big trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in maintaining a consistent exercise routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how does regular exercise impact mental health?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone who wants to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about art and creativity.
questions: Q1: Can you describe a creative project you have worked on?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to be creative?
Q3: How do you think art influences society today?
Q4: What recommendations would you make for fostering creativity in others?
